declared_exclusions.item: The T-1 completeness at 06:00 New York is inferred, not measured.

IRPT_BCKEND-D2-W404-S2: the transactions feed has thirteen trading days without a flat key against the order's seven, six of them 2026-05-04 to 2026-05-11; recorded, the order's seven kept.

IRPT_BCKEND-D2-W404-S3: BLOCKING; the catalog rows of the three pull steps carry no date token and run_chain refuses --run-date for date-agnostic steps, so a past-day re-run through them is not expressible until the S3 catalog changes.
IRPT_BCKEND-D2-W404-S4: ARMED; the gold dispatch catalog lives only at an S3 object with no repository copy, so its edits are not version-controlled in this tree.
IRPT_BCKEND-D2-W404-S5: BLOCKING; the silver aggregator has no source in the tree, so its direct dispatch of inf-gold-trigger cannot be read or retired from source.

IRPT_BCKEND-D2-W404-S7: two stale timing comments disagree with Terraform and with the measured landings (the bronze trigger docstring and the dispatch script's pull comment).
IRPT_BCKEND-D2-W404-S8: the gold trigger's BLOCKED text reads as an active hold while the Terraform release control is set and its provenance reads CURED and LIFTED.
IRPT_BCKEND-D2-W404-S9: ARMED; a tolerated pull failure leaves a day's key absent while the chain reports complete.
IRPT_BCKEND-D2-W404-S10: the positions manual CLI's docstring names a parquet key the write no longer produces (the write is a flat .jsonl.gz key).
